transcript: I've learned that time is simultaneously beautiful and scary. The more that I sit and I think about moments and experiences that I've had, time has refined me. In that development, I have learned that my peace and comfort are everything for me. It will sacrifice anything in order to have my peace. And within knowing that I've learned to be okay with movements. I've learned to be okay with listening to my first thought and taking action. I'm not willing to allow anything in this world to distract me from my happiness and from my peace.
